description: Use when writing, building, or reviewing Go programs on an authorized engineering task. Covers module setup with go mod, building and cross-compiling, gofmt and go vet hygiene, unit testing with the testing package, error handling idioms, goroutines and channels for concurrency, the race detector, and static binaries for deployment. Use when starting a Go CLI, service, scanner, or tool, or when auditing Go code for correctness.
